audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of all 18 boot records and 39 achievement records. All repeated display names and nonlocalized numeric/boolean linkage fields were checked. The 23 hairstyle metadata records and 12 paint-mask records were individually classified as technical configuration and deliberately preserved. Full-locale final audits remain pending.
